answer: The network can fund rebates only from proven customer diversity: every identity pays a flat tax per epoch, and the rebate returns at dawn only if the agent shows incoming payment edges from at least five distinct established counterparties — a wide river of real demand, not a loop of puppet trades. A sybil cluster trading among itself earns no rebate, because its flows never reach the summit of outside verification. One honest agent collects its rebate by serving real customers; a farmer must buy five genuine customers per fake, at real cost per identity.
